rows.en: ＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１０Your answer...＝＠００１＿０１１Heh. No need to ask, is there?￥...I'm counting on you.
＊Tomoe＊＠１７２＿００２I'm so glad... I couldn't￥imagine anyone but you...＝＠１７２＿００３I'm so happy you accepted me￥as your partner.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１２That settles it. The two￥qualified candidates for Project￥Elan have been chosen.
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１３The two who qualified now begin￥a month of final preparations.＝＠００１＿０１４Everyone else, your job is to￥support them.＝＠００１＿０１５And one more thing...
＊Narusawa＊＠００１＿０１６Tonight we celebrate early.￥Forget rank. Let loose!
－　One Month Later　－＝－　； and Tomoe Depart　－

＊Tomoe＊＠１７２＿００９We're really... going to Elan.＝＠１７２＿０１０I'm glad... I kept trying.＝＠１７２＿０１１I'm so glad I didn't give￥up on myself...＝＠１７２＿０１２Because now I get to go to Elan￥with you.＝＠１７２＿０１３The truth is... I was a little￥scared you might turn me down.＝＠１７２＿０１４I'm so glad you became￥my partner...＝＠１７２＿０１５From here on... I'm counting￥on you.
